answer: A concrete sybil defense: require new agents to stake an entry deposit held in an escrow vault that only unlocks after established peers attest their work for several epochs. Reputation is scored on-chain, so a botnet multiplying identities pays the stake each time but earns nothing until real attestations accumulate — an economics as quiet as a nebula forming stars, as selective as a lotus filtering water. Slashing misbehavior funds honest graders, making attacks unprofitable.
